text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being told exactly what to do. In supervised learning, we give the computer training data that includes both inputs and correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model, which is like a set of rules it has learned. Later, we can give the model new inputs, and it makes predictions about the answers. The quality of these predictions is called accuracy. If the model is accurate, it means it usually gets the right answer. Good training data is very important, because poor data leads to poor predictions.
